about: Every open decision that affects design, with the neutral placeholder allowed now and what may not be assumed, and the design questions the owner has decided. affected_surfaces is derived from surfaces.json and checked. An owner_reading, a working_default or an owner design decision is the owner's, never a client confirmation.

kinds.client_decision: An open decision of the register, Part Six. The client's.
kinds.working_default: An open client decision with an owner working default (docs/scope/open-items.json). Not client-confirmed.
kinds.client_input: Content or material the client supplies (register, Part Five).
kinds.erp: Waits for the ERP Integration Specification.
kinds.owner_reading: A contradiction in the register resolved by the owner. Not client-confirmed.
kinds.vendor: Waits for a provider account, sandbox or document.
kinds.open_point: An open point of the sitemap companion, section 7.

placeholders.title: Brand name, logo and visual identity
placeholders.unknown: The brand name, the logo, the colours, the typefaces and the rules for using them.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Neutral tokens only: greys, one system typeface per script, a labelled box where the logo goes, the working name in plain text.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No logo, no client colour, no final typeface, no imagery style, no tone of voice. Nothing that could be read as a visual proposal.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client supplies the brand identity and approves the brand direction in writing (CR-02). Tokens and assets are then set and the high-fidelity stage begins.

placeholders.title: Welcome discount: value, cap, expiry, eligibility
placeholders.unknown: The client's real values.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Show the discount as a variable: a labelled amount and its conditions. The owner's example default is in docs/scope/open-items.json.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not print a value as if agreed. Do not show the discount where its conditions are not met.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's values, set in the admin under BR-001.

placeholders.title: Free shipping: what two items means
placeholders.unknown: Two units or two distinct products, and any exclusions.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: The prompt reads from the rule. Owner default: two or more units, any mix, no exclusions.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not hard-code 'two'. Do not draw exclusions.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's confirmation of the rule. The condition stays admin-configurable (BR-002).

placeholders.title: Cash on delivery: offered or not
placeholders.unknown: Whether cash on delivery is offered at launch.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Draw payment selection with and without cash on delivery. The capability is built either way (PAY-09).
placeholders.must_not_assume: No value ceiling, no fee, no verification step: none is contracted (OP-03, PAY-10 is P2).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's decision.

placeholders.title: Return window and exceptions
placeholders.unknown: The return window and any product-type exceptions.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Placeholder policy text and a variable for the window on the product page summary.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No number of days. No automatic eligibility check, no return form, no returns area (RET-01, RET-03, ACCT-10 are deferred).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's policy and the policy text (CR-04).

placeholders.title: VAT and invoicing requirements
placeholders.unknown: What an invoice must carry for the client's legal entity.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: An invoice layout with labelled regions for seller details, tax lines and numbering.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No tax rate, no registration number, no statutory wording. No e-invoice or e-receipt (INT-17 is out).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's invoicing requirements and legal entity details.

placeholders.title: Authenticity and warranty policy
placeholders.unknown: The policy wording and any supporting documents.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: A statement region on the product page and a policy page with placeholder text.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No guarantee wording, no warranty period, no certificate imagery.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's policy and documents.

placeholders.title: Domain, sending address, support numbers, legal entity details
placeholders.unknown: The contact and legal details shown in the footer, on the contact page, on invoices and in emails.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Labelled placeholder fields.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No real address, phone number, domain or company name.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's details, before launch.

placeholders.title: Payment methods at launch
placeholders.unknown: Cards only, or cards and wallets.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Draw both. Owner default: cards and wallets are launch-capable.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not draw instalments, kiosk payment or Instapay (PAY-20, PAY-21, PAY-22).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's choice, and the provider's approval of wallets for the merchant account (PAY-15).

placeholders.title: Carrier cash-on-delivery remittance cycle
placeholders.unknown: How and when the carrier remits collected cash.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Two states per order: collected, remitted.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No cycle length, no settlement report layout.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's or the carrier's answer.

placeholders.title: Carrier account and rate card by governorate
placeholders.unknown: The zones, the rates and any delivery estimates.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Invented governorates and rates from the staging seed.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No real rate. No live rate lookup (SHIP-02 is P2).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's rate card.

placeholders.title: Legal and policy text
placeholders.unknown: The wording of the privacy, terms, shipping, returns and authenticity pages.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Placeholder text of realistic length, headings included, in both languages.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No legal wording written as if final.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's text.

placeholders.title: Product and brand photography
placeholders.unknown: The real images.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Neutral image boxes at the intended aspect ratios, and the invented products of the staging seed.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No stock photography that suggests a visual direction.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's photographs, and the image rights confirmation (CR-08, OD-26).

placeholders.title: Storefront content in both languages
placeholders.unknown: Category names, collection names, the brand list, page copy, and the final Arabic wording of the account addresses.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Invented content from the staging seed, in both languages, including long strings.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No real category tree, brand list or campaign.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's content. The mechanism is ours and the content is theirs.

placeholders.title: ERP Integration Specification
placeholders.unknown: When and how the store reads stock, what the customer sees when stock cannot be validated, how reservation works, and how stock appears in the admin.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Structural stock states: in stock, out of stock, unknown or cannot validate, and a changed cart line. Neutral placeholder wording.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No timing, no mechanism, no 'only N left', no reservation timer, no stock quantity shown to customers, no admin stock editing behaviour. No P1-E surface beyond a placeholder.
placeholders.replaced_by: PRE-09 written, agreed with the ERP team and approved by the client.

placeholders.title: The Accountant role
placeholders.unknown: Whether the client acknowledges the role as the owner resolved it.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Permission states that hide or refuse an action. Refund permission is a separate capability.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No Accountant-only screen or report. ROLE-06 still reads DEF and advanced financial reporting is P2 (ROLE-06a).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's acknowledgement of MS-CLR-2026-037.

placeholders.title: The restricted Marketing access profile
placeholders.unknown: Whether the client confirms the reading.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Only the permission states MKT-21 to MKT-25 need.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No Marketing role screen. ROLE-05 is deferred.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's confirmation.

placeholders.title: The narrow audit record
placeholders.unknown: Whether the client confirms the reading.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: A list of recorded events for the rows that explicitly require history (ADM-50, ADM-132 to ADM-134).
placeholders.must_not_assume: No full audit trail of refunds, permissions or stock (ROLE-10 and ADM-125 are deferred). No forensic reporting.
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's confirmation.

placeholders.title: Dashboard counts for orders needing action and pending refunds
placeholders.unknown: Whether the client confirms the reading.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: A count with a link to the standard filtered list.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No custom queue, no worked-top-to-bottom view, no saved views (ADM-120, ADM-141, ADM-144 are deferred).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's confirmation.

placeholders.title: Scheduling on the promotional banner alone
placeholders.unknown: Whether the client confirms the reading.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Start, optional end, page placement and enabled state on the banner.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No scheduling on any other section (HOME-12 and ADM-62 are P2).
placeholders.replaced_by: The client's confirmation.

placeholders.title: Payment provider interface
placeholders.unknown: The exact hosted or embedded step, its return behaviour and its error codes, as the merchant account is configured.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Our handoff, loading, verifying, failure and return states, with a labelled box for the provider's step.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not draw the provider's card form, 3-D Secure screen or wallet screen. Do not promise an embedded step where the provider redirects.
placeholders.replaced_by: The merchant account and the sandbox, in #283.

placeholders.title: Carrier status legend and tracking
placeholders.unknown: The carrier's status codes and how each maps to an order status.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: The contracted order statuses only, and a labelled link out for the carrier's page.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No carrier status the mapping has not fixed. No live map, no courier details.
placeholders.replaced_by: The carrier's status legend and the documented mapping (SHIP-14), in #291.

placeholders.title: Google sign-in
placeholders.unknown: The client's Google credentials and the button variant Google requires.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: A neutral 'Continue with Google' button of the required size.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not restyle Google's mark. Do not draw Google's account chooser or consent screen.
placeholders.replaced_by: The Google sign-in credentials, in #305.

placeholders.title: Cash on delivery limits and fees
placeholders.unknown: Two stories promise a value limit, zone restriction or fee that no row contracts.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Cash on delivery as an on or off method.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No limit and no fee.
placeholders.replaced_by: The Stage 1 review of the Functional Specification.

placeholders.title: Returns in the account dashboard
placeholders.unknown: A story gives the dashboard a route to returns, which are deferred.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: An account with no returns entry.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No returns link, tab or status.
placeholders.replaced_by: The Stage 1 review.

placeholders.title: Recommendations in the find journey
placeholders.unknown: JRN-02 names recommendations and cites no row for them.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Curated, hand-picked rails only: trending, new arrivals, collections, related products.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No personalised recommendation (JRN-12 and HOME-13 are P3).
placeholders.replaced_by: The Stage 1 review.

placeholders.title: Reductions the register does not state
placeholders.unknown: What the reduced specification of JRN-05 and JRN-08 is, and what the first release provides in place of IA-33.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Draw the rows as worded.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not invent a reduction or a stand-in.
placeholders.replaced_by: The Stage 1 review.

placeholders.title: Whether a chosen language is remembered
placeholders.unknown: The story says the choice persists. The built site takes the language from the address only.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: A switcher that changes the address. No remembered state shown.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No language prompt, no auto-redirect by location or browser.
placeholders.replaced_by: An owner decision, then a requirement PR to spec 002 if behaviour changes.

placeholders.title: What a language switch does mid-task
placeholders.unknown: No source says what happens to a search in progress, a part-completed checkout or the order confirmation.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: The switcher present on every page, landing on the counterpart address.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not promise that form entries survive a switch. Do not hide the switcher in checkout.
placeholders.replaced_by: An owner decision in #253.

placeholders.title: Two page rows, one address
placeholders.unknown: Sign in and register are one address. Collections and curated collection pages are one route.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: One screen with both forms, and one collection template.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No separate register address or second collection template.
placeholders.replaced_by: An owner decision. A change is a requirement PR to spec 003.

placeholders.title: No index pages
placeholders.unknown: No page lists all categories, all collections or all brands, and no source says whether one is intended.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Reach them through the navigation and the home page sections.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not draw an index page as if contracted.
placeholders.replaced_by: An owner decision. A change is a requirement PR to spec 003.

placeholders.title: Profile and password screens have no page row
placeholders.unknown: ACCT-02 and ACCT-03 are contracted and have no IA row and no entry in the URL map.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: The standard account-details screen.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No new address.
placeholders.replaced_by: An owner decision. A change is a requirement PR to spec 003.

placeholders.title: Tracking sits outside the account
placeholders.unknown: The register groups tracking under the account. It is built as a separate page with a lookup, and on the order for signed-in customers.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: Both: the lookup page and the status on the order.
placeholders.must_not_assume: Do not merge or remove either without a decision.
placeholders.replaced_by: An owner decision. A change is a requirement PR to spec 003.

placeholders.title: CHK-12 names a method
placeholders.unknown: The row says stock is reserved in the ERP, while reservation is among the matters PRE-09 has not decided.
placeholders.placeholder_allowed: A failure state when stock is no longer available.
placeholders.must_not_assume: No reservation timer or countdown.
placeholders.replaced_by: PRE-09.

owner_design_decisions_about: Boundaries the owner decided on 6 October 2026 (DECISIONS.md D-14) for questions no source answered. Owner design decisions: not client confirmations, and not scope additions. They are locked, and no surface waits on one. A UX pattern with more than one legitimate answer is not here: it is in interaction-options.json, as open or provisional.

owner_design_decisions.title: Second-release screens
owner_design_decisions.question: The register stages some contracted rows S2. No source says whether their screens are drawn in the first design.
owner_design_decisions.decision: Every S2 surface stays in the master inventory and is not wireframed during the S1 wireframe pass. Its attachment point is accounted for, so the S1 structure does not prevent the later S2 work.
owner_design_decisions.must_not: No S2 wireframe in the S1 pass, and no S1 layout that leaves the S2 surface nowhere to attach.
owner_design_decisions.boundary: This governs the low-fidelity S1 wireframe pass only. Statement of Work section 9 measures the contracted interface design by every contracted storefront screen of the register, and second-release rows are contracted. Whether their screens are part of the design presented for PRE-03b is not settled here and is the owner's to decide before that design is presented.

owner_design_decisions.title: The cash-collected state
owner_design_decisions.question: ORD-14 is a state for the store's books. No source says whether a customer sees it.
owner_design_decisions.decision: Cash collected and remitted is a staff and accounting state. The customer sees the normal delivered or completed state.
owner_design_decisions.must_not: The customer is never shown the carrier remittance or accounting state.

owner_design_decisions.title: Review eligibility
owner_design_decisions.question: No row says whether a review needs an account or a purchase.
owner_design_decisions.decision: The Stage 1 design assumes a signed-in customer may submit a review.
owner_design_decisions.must_not: No verified-purchase requirement and no verified-purchase badge: neither is contracted (REV-07 is P2).

owner_design_decisions.title: The consent banner
owner_design_decisions.question: MKT-10 contracts a consent banner. The tool is selected in #288 and has its own layout limits.
owner_design_decisions.decision: The structural design covers Accept, Decline and Preferences. The exact visual and layout implementation stays constrained by the consent tool selected in #288.
owner_design_decisions.must_not: No third-party banner implementation is invented that the eventual tool cannot support.
